steps.name: sync-and-build-exact-main
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch origin main; git checkout -B main origin/main; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "d4f73bef621a198d384d5ba9ff3e1a775c3aa57a"; export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"; ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug --no-daemon

steps.name: connect-and-verify-s22
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; SEL='192.168.0.100:46769'; adb start-server >/dev/null; adb connect "$SEL"; sleep 2; adb devices -l; M="$(adb -s "$SEL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')"; S="$(adb -s "$SEL" shell getprop ro.serialno | tr -d '\r')"; test "$M" = 'SM-S906B'; test "$S" = 'RFCT70L7E8J'; printf '%s' "$SEL" >/tmp/aicall-s22-selector; echo 'verified_s22=true'

steps.name: install-exact-apk
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; SEL="$(cat /tmp/aicall-s22-selector)"; APK='app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk'; test -f "$APK"; adb -s "$SEL" install --no-streaming -r "$APK"; echo 'apk_installed=true'

steps.name: launch-and-inspect-permissions
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; SEL="$(cat /tmp/aicall-s22-selector)"; adb -s "$SEL" shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; adb -s "$SEL" shell monkey -p pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge 1 >/dev/null; sleep 2; OUT="$(adb -s "$SEL" shell dumpsys package pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge)"; echo 'app_launched=true'; for P in android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO android.permission.CALL_PHONE android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE android.permission.ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS; do MATCH="$(printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -E "$P: granted=(true|false)" | head -1 || true)"; echo "${MATCH:-$P: grant_state=unknown}"; done; echo '--- foreground ---'; adb -s "$SEL" shell dumpsys window | grep -E 'mCurrentFocus|mFocusedApp' | head -4 || true
